SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.username, u.email, u.full_name, u.department, u.position, u.status, u.created_at AS user_created_at,
r.id AS role_id, r.role_code, r.role_name, r.description AS role_desc, r.created_at AS role_created_at,
p.id AS perm_id, p.perm_code, p.perm_name, p.resource_type, p.url_pattern, p.description AS perm_desc, p.created_at AS perm_created_at
FROM users u INNER JOIN user_role ur ON u.id = ur.user_id INNER JOIN role r ON ur.role_id = r.id INNER JOIN role_permission rp ON r.id = rp.role_id INNER JOIN permission p ON rp.permission_id = p.id WHERE u.status = 1 ORDER BY u.id, r.id, p.id

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.username, u.email, u.full_name, u.department, u.position, u.status, u.created_at AS user_created_at,
r.id AS role_id, r.role_code, r.role_name, r.description AS role_desc, r.created_at AS role_created_at,
p.id AS perm_id, p.perm_code, p.perm_name, p.resource_type, p.url_pattern, p.description AS perm_desc, p.created_at AS perm_created_at
FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_role ur ON u.id = ur.user_id LEFT JOIN role r ON ur.role_id = r.id LEFT JOIN role_permission rp ON r.id = rp.role_id LEFT JOIN permission p ON rp.permission_id = p.id WHERE u.id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.id, p.id
